title: 第73章 只有唐画能碾压小诗仙！
novel_title: 唐逸孔诗岚全文完结版
content_zh: 众人骂得热火朝天，唐敬却安静坐在角落里自顾喝酒，没有理会。　　唐画双手拢在袖中，安静站在唐敬的身后，也没有参与讨论。　　他脸色平静，似乎并不在意周围所议论的一切，只是此时现在却充斥着疯狂和嫉妒。　　该死的，都是因为唐逸和这莫名其妙的小诗仙，不然，现在整个京都都是他三元及第的传奇。　　结果现在他三元及第，小诗仙文采风流，唐逸大闹庆功宴，都成了京都热议的话题。　　他的光芒不再是光芒，还有各种嘲讽，被戏称千年最惨状元。　　这简直就是耻辱！　　“唐逸，等着吧，有你在我脚下哀嚎的时候。”　　唐画藏在袖中的手紧攥成拳，怒火中烧。　　户部尚书刘温听着众人的议论，脸色也是难看至极。　　他们在大炎呼风唤雨，位高权重。　　可现在，连一个小诗仙都没有揪出来，只能望着他的诗词惊叹！　　他敲了敲桌案，目光落在刑部侍郎赵轲的身上。　　“怎么？都查这么久了？你们刑部还是没查出小诗仙是谁？”　　刘温是有些不满的，刑部和大理寺，主管大炎各种案子的调查和复核。　　追踪调查，那都是刑部和大理寺的拿手好戏。　　但断了无数大案要案的刑部，这次在小诗仙这个问题上，办事竟然非常的拖拉，没有以往的半点爽利。　　这都过去多少天了？小诗仙的影子都没逮到。　　“我说了，我查到的小诗仙，就是唐逸。”　　说起这个赵轲脸色也不好看，道：“但我又仔细查了唐逸的资料，发现最不可能是小诗仙的，也是他……”　　说到这里，赵轲下意识看了一眼唐敬和唐画。　　呵呵，还真是不查不知道，一查吓一跳。　　还真没想到道貌岸然的吏部侍郎唐大人，温润君子的唐家大少，家里竟然还藏着这么多龌龊事呢。　　一个长期被外室子欺凌得胆小懦弱的少年，怎么可能会是才华横溢的小诗仙？　　唐敬没有说话，唐画微微拱手道：“侍郎大人，你看我父亲也没用，还是那句话，诗仙不可能是唐逸。”　　唐敬放下酒杯，声音平静道：“那逆子这段时间是有些叛逆，是挺能折腾，甚至害得唐家声名扫地。”　　“但他要是小诗仙，我能将这桌子吃了。”　　唐敬也没有隐藏唐家的那点事。　　对他来说高门大户中的阴暗事多了去了，唐逸和唐画他们之间那点恩怨，算得了什么？　　在朝堂有朝堂的争斗，在家族就有家族的争斗。　　弱肉强食，适者生存，这是法则。　　“不过，不管小诗仙是谁，很快就会浮出水面了。”　　唐敬目光看向众人，道：“别忘了，再过几日，就是孔家主办的沈园诗会了。”　　众人闻言皆是一怔。　　随即，所有人看向唐敬和唐画的目光，都有些说不清道不明的意味。　　原本沈园诗会，只是孔家大小姐为反抗联姻小打小闹的把戏，只是不知为何陛下莫名其妙插手，将事情闹大了。　　现在沈园诗会，是孔明箴孔老太傅亲自发的请帖。　　他老人家亲自发请帖，整个京都有几个人敢不给面子？　　只是现在众人诧异的是，唐敬为何忽然提起沈园诗会？　　沈园诗会，和小诗仙有什么关系？　　刘温眉头微皱，道：“唐大人的意思是，小诗仙会参加孔太傅主办的沈园诗会？”　　唐敬点了点头，将自己的猜测说出来。　　“不是参加，我怀疑整个沈园诗会，就是陛下为小诗仙量身打造的舞台。”　　“陛下就是想要借助这次舞台，让小诗仙彻底进入所有人的视野。”　　“陛下，在给他铺路，而我们所有人都是他的垫脚石！”　　众人陡然一片死寂。　　什么？沈园诗会竟然是这样的内幕？　　陛下竟然为了小诗仙，亲自给他搭建了一个让他一飞冲天的舞台？　　而且还是踩着他们的脸一飞冲天。　　这能忍？！　　“可恶，想要踩着我们一飞冲天，他想屁吃呢？”　　“哼，真没想到，陛下竟然能为小诗仙做到这一步。”　　“这如何是好？如果真是这样，凭这个人的诗才，我们如何阻止？”　　“……”　　整个房间瞬间喧嚣起来，众人都义愤填膺。　　陛下，你过分了。　　为了一个不知好歹的小诗仙，你竟然要将满朝文武的脸面按在地上摩擦，他一个小诗仙，真有那么重要？　　刘温和赵轲相视一眼，脸色也都阴沉至极。　　如果真如唐敬所说，那小诗仙，就更不可能是唐逸了。　　唐家那软弱无能的废物，就算和陛下有接触，但凭他的身份和能力，能让陛下下这么重的注？　　几乎偏执到孤注一掷的地步。　　“谁说没人能阻止小诗仙，我们不是还有唐家大公子吗？”　　这时，刘温忽然看向唐画。　　虽然唐画的庆功宴遭到唐逸破坏，但区区一个庆功宴，还是遮挡不了唐画三元及第的光环。　　这让刘温看向唐敬的目光都有些嫉妒：“有唐画在，陛下想要让小诗仙踩着我们的脸上位，就没有那么容易。”　　“能写出《劝谏诗》的大才，和小诗仙绝对有一战之力。”　　众人一听，顿时都齐刷刷看向唐画。　　对啊！陛下有小诗仙，咱们不是也有唐画吗？　　当初一首《劝谏诗》，在大殿上震耳欲聋，连陛下都被震得一愣一愣的，谁敢说他不如小诗仙？　　“没错，陛下有小诗仙，咱们不是还有唐状元吗？”　　“陛下想要用小诗仙来踩我们一脚，那也得先过唐画这一关，但是，他过得了吗？”　　“哈哈，那这样可就有意思了，陛下想要用小诗仙压我们，那咱们完全可以用唐画反过来压他嘛！”　　“……”　　众人议论纷纷，激动不已。　　皇帝想要用小诗仙让他们难堪，那他们也完全可以以其人之道还治其人之身，让唐画在较量上狠狠踩皇帝。　　好叫皇帝知道，什么叫搬起石头砸自己的脚。　　唐画看着激动得已经开始布置战术的众人，心脏在此时都在收缩。　　别人不知道怎么回事，他还不知道怎么回事？　　《劝谏诗》写得震撼全场，可那是抄袭小诗仙的。　　虽然他不认为唐逸和那所谓的小诗仙，敢在沈园诗会这样的场合，来揭穿他这个陛下钦点的状元。　　毕竟他们没有证据，总不能相互指认吧？　　“说得对，现在只有我家画儿，能碾压小诗仙了”　　唐敬拱手自信道。
content_en: Everyone was yelling at them, but Tang Jing sat quietly in the corner and drank by himself, paying no attention to them.Tang Hua folded his hands in his sleeves and stood quietly behind Tang Jing, not participating in the discussion.His face was calm, as if he didn't care about everything being said around him, but at this moment he was filled with madness and jealousy.Damn it, it's all because of Tang Yi and this inexplicable little poetry fairy, otherwise, the whole of Kyoto would be the legend of his three yuan success.As a result, now he has passed the imperial examination in three yuan, the poet is a literary talent, and Tang Yi holds a grand celebration banquet, which has become a hot topic in Kyoto.His radiance is no longer radiance, but also all kinds of ridicule, and he is jokingly called the worst number one pick in a thousand years.This is simply a shame!"Tang Yi, just wait until you are wailing at my feet." Tang Hua's hands hidden in his sleeves were clenched into fists, burning with anger.Liu Wen, Shangshu of the Ministry of Revenue, looked extremely ugly as he listened to everyone's discussion.They control the wind and rain in Dayan and hold a high position of power.But now, I haven't even found out a little poetry fairy, I can only look at his poems and marvel!He knocked on the table and his eyes fell on Zhao Ke, the Minister of Justice."What? It's been investigating for so long? Your Punishment Department still hasn't found out who Xiao Shixian is?" Liu Wen was a little dissatisfied. The Punishment Department and Dali Temple were in charge of the investigation and review of various cases in Dayan.Tracking and investigating are the specialty of the Ministry of Punishment and Dali Temple.But the Criminal Department, which has solved countless major cases, was very procrastinating on the issue of Xiao Shixian this time, not as smooth as in the past.How many days have passed?Little Shixian was not even caught."I said, the little poetry fairy I found is Tang Yi." Speaking of this, Zhao Ke's face didn't look good, and said: "But I checked Tang Yi's information carefully, and found that the person who is least likely to be the little poetry fairy is him..." At this point, Zhao Ke subconsciously glanced at Tang Jing and Tang Hua.Haha, I really don’t know if I don’t check. I’ll be shocked if I check.I really didn’t expect that Mr. Tang, the sanctimonious minister of the Ministry of Civil Affairs, and the gentle and gentle young man of the Tang family, would have so many dirty things hidden in his family.How could a young man who had been bullied by an outsider for a long time become a cowardly young man and become a talented little poetry fairy?Tang Jing did not speak, Tang Hua slightly cupped his hands and said: "Master Minister, it's useless to look at my father. As I said, the Immortal Poetry cannot be Tang Yi." Tang Jing put down his wine glass and said in a calm voice: "The traitor has been a bit rebellious during this period. He is quite capable of tossing, and even brought the Tang family's reputation into disrepute." "But if he is the Immortal Poetry, I can eat this table." Tang Jing did not hide the things about the Tang family.To him, there were too many dark things in the wealthy family. What did the grudge between Tang Yi and Tang Hua mean?There are court battles in the court, and family battles in the family.The law of the jungle is the survival of the fittest."However, no matter who the little poetry fairy is, he will surface soon." Tang Jing looked at everyone and said, "Don't forget, in a few days, the Shenyuan Poetry Recital hosted by the Kong family will be held." Everyone was startled when they heard this.Immediately, everyone looked at Tang Jing and Tang Hua with some inexplicable meaning.Originally, the Shen Yuan Poetry Club was just a prank by the eldest daughter of the Kong family to resist the marriage, but for some unknown reason, His Majesty intervened inexplicably and made the matter bigger.The invitation to the Shenyuan Poetry Recital was personally sent by Kong Mingzhen, Mrs. Kong.The old man personally sent out the invitations. How many people in the entire capital would dare not to give him face?But what everyone is surprised about now is why Tang Jing suddenly mentioned the Shenyuan Poetry Club?What does Shen Yuan Poetry Club have to do with Xiao Shixian?Liu Wen frowned slightly and said, "Master Tang, what you mean is that the little poetry fairy will participate in the Shenyuan Poetry Party hosted by Kong Taifu?" Tang Jing nodded and expressed his guess."Instead of participating, I suspect that the entire Shen Yuan Poetry Recital is a stage tailor-made by His Majesty for the Little Shixian." "Your Majesty just wants to use this stage to bring the Little Shixian into everyone's sight." "Your Majesty, you are paving the way for him, and all of us are his stepping stones!" There was a sudden silence among everyone.What?What is the inside story of Shen Yuan Poetry Club?Your Majesty, for the sake of the little Shixian, you personally set up a stage for him to soar into the sky?And he still stepped on their faces and flew into the sky.Can this be tolerated?!"Damn it, he wants to step on us and fly into the sky. What does he want to eat?" "Hmph, I really didn't expect that His Majesty could do this for the little poetry fairy." "What should we do? If this is really the case, with this person's poetic talent, how can we stop it?" "..." The whole room suddenly became noisy, and everyone was filled with indignation.Your Majesty, you have gone too far.For the sake of a little poetry fairy who knows no good, you actually want to rub the face of Man Chao Wenwu on the ground. Is he, a little poetry fairy, really that important?Liu Wen and Zhao Ke looked at each other, their faces extremely gloomy.If it is true as Tang Jing said, then the little poetry fairy is even less likely to be Tang Yi.Even if that weak and incompetent loser from the Tang family has contact with His Majesty, with his status and ability, can His Majesty place such a heavy bet?Almost paranoid to the point of being desperate."Who said no one can stop the little Shixian? Don't we still have the eldest son of the Tang family?" At this time, Liu Wen suddenly looked at Tang Hua.Although Tang Hua's celebration banquet was ruined by Tang Yi, a mere celebration banquet could not block the aura of Tang Hua's third place.This made Liu Wen look at Tang Jing with a bit of jealousy: "With Tang Hua here, it will not be so easy for Your Majesty to let the little Shixian step on our faces." "A great talent who can write the "Poetry of Admonition" will definitely be able to compete with the little Shixian." When everyone heard this, they all looked at Tang Hua.yes!Your Majesty has a little poetry fairy, don’t we also have Tang paintings?Back then, a "poem of advice" was deafening in the hall, and even His Majesty was stunned for a moment. Who dares to say that he is not as good as the little poetry fairy?"That's right, your Majesty has a little poetry fairy, don't we still have the number one scholar of the Tang Dynasty?" "If your majesty wants to use the little poetry fairy to step on us, he has to pass the Tang painting test first, but has he passed it?" "Haha, that would be interesting, your majesty thought.
title_en: Chapter 73 Only Tang Hua can crush the little poetry fairy!
